question: What status can body-worship confer and where is this taught?
premises: Through body-worship a person can become a vow-holder.
This can occur even without a mandala.
This teaching about body-worship is given in the Siddhayogishvari tradition.
inference: Body-worship alone is sufficient to establish vow-holder status, according to the Siddhayogishvari teaching.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or initiatory threshold implied by samayī is not fully spelled out here.
plain_english: By performing body-worship, even without a mandala, a person can become a vow-holder. This is the teaching on body-worship found in the revered Siddhayogishvari tradition.
